results.effect_size: LS mean difference -0.47% A1C (95% CI: -0.66 to -0.28) in favor of sitagliptin/metformin FDC vs pioglitazone
biomarker_changes: Sitagliptin/Metformin FDC: A1C LS mean change -1.86% vs pioglitazone -1.39% at week 32
Sitagliptin/Metformin FDC: FPG LS mean change -40.5 mg/dL at week 1 vs pioglitazone -13.0 mg/dL
Sitagliptin/Metformin FDC: FPG LS mean change -56.0 mg/dL at week 32 vs pioglitazone -44.0 mg/dL
Sitagliptin/Metformin FDC: 2-hour PMG LS mean change -102.2 mg/dL at week 32 vs pioglitazone -82.0 mg/dL
57.3% of sitagliptin/metformin FDC patients achieved A1C <7.0% vs 43.5% pioglitazone (OR 2.0, 95% CI 1.3–2.8)
